scope: per-generation guest IRQ-work identity, failed-delivery recovery and reclamation
findings: the fixed boot header cannot grow in place because cpu_table immediately follows it; a native-revision-gated extension must follow all variable boot tables and carry magic, version, size and generation
guest work slots are a contiguous 64-byte-per-source-CPU retained allocation; raised_list contains the exact guest slot pointer and a failed IPI leaves the node linked and BUSY

the descriptor must publish retained physical identity, exact count/stride and release-ready state; the host must validate retained range, disjointness, alignment and checked geometry before translating through the reviewed direct map
a generation gate/sender lease must span BUSY acquisition, list insertion, IPI result and final slot access; close waits for zero senders before draining

irq_work_sync only waits and cannot repair a failed initial delivery; recovery must retry the exact IRQ_WORK_VECTOR to the retained target, and an offline target requires quarantine/retention rather than unlink or reuse
smallest_next_fixture: two source slots and two targets; suppress the first vector, prove linked BUSY state, retry and prove one callback/list empty/BUSY clear, quarantine an offline target, and reject stale-generation completion against a newer generation
acceptance: Design review only. No descriptor, retry path, drain, build, guest, reclamation or lifecycle acceptance exists.
